Definition
1. Definition 5.19\group ch05-viscosity-solutions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0116 A function $g$ is $L^n$-Hölder continuous at $0$ with exponent $\alpha $ if \[ [g]_{C^\alpha _{L^n}}(0) :=\sup _{0<r<1}r^{-\alpha } \left(\frac1{|B_r|}\int _{B_r}|g-g(0)|^n\right)^{1/n}<\infty . \]
